def transform(grid):
    # Reflect the grid horizontally into a 2x-wide cell pattern, and vertically
    # repeat a reflected row ordering three times.
    base = [[row[1], row[0], row[0], row[1]] for row in grid]
    seq = list(reversed(base))
    return (seq + list(reversed(seq)) + seq)
PY
